source_policy: One complete actual recording; arithmetic channel mean; no generated events or tracks; no truth supplied to search.

pcm_comparison.lag_rule: Evenly spaced fixed windows; report each measured lag; never shift comparisons by fitted lag.
pcm_comparison.gain_rule: Remove only the declared gain for comparison; no fitted normalization.
pcm_comparison.reference: Decoded canonical mono PCM before MP3 encoding

event_correspondence.assignment: Minimum-cost one-to-one assignment, maximizing eligible pairs first; cost is one minus overlap fraction plus median frequency difference divided by 25 Hz.
event_correspondence.ridge_comparison: Interpolate the second mapped ridge at first-ridge times within their overlap; do not extrapolate.
event_correspondence.groups: Report unmatched ridges and groups, group splits and group merges; IDs and row order are not correspondence.

time_mapping.padding_request: Subtract leading_silence_s from BOTH sample-zero UTC window endpoints.
time_mapping.event_mapping: Subtract leading_silence_s from audio-relative event and ridge times.
time_mapping.clock_mapping: Add leading_silence_s to fitted sample-zero UTC to recover the original recording clock.
time_mapping.codec_delay: Use first decoded sample after ffmpeg skip/discard; retain first-packet side data, decoded sample counts and residual lag checks.

execution.fresh_work: Each arm starts a fresh local HTTP service and job with original upload bytes; no saved intake, discovery, search or decision is reused.
execution.shared_data: Only pinned immutable historical indexes and terrain may be shared; require an offline operator.
execution.failure_policy: Retain encoding, usability, verification, terminal and incomplete outcomes. Continue other cases after ordinary failures; stop and preserve pending cases on interruption or changed pinned inputs.
execution.truth_policy: No eligible independent truth is supplied in this protocol. Truth error is explicitly not evaluated. Pairwise displacement is not accuracy.

unsupported: detector spectral window/hop via the upload operator
search scheduling chunks as an equivalent audio representation

outcome_policy: Compare all status/reason, coverage, work-completion and uncertainty-provenance transitions. Compare diagnostic candidates separately from accepted locations. Accepted jumps above 1000 m are serious findings. Regional source-informed runs do not satisfy national acceptance.
